Data:A u evening.json.label: Evening Falls
Data:A u evening.json.descriptionunlocked: I lived out my days quietly, as the Librarian of Hush House; and I was happy.

Data:A u winter.json.label: A Knowledge In The Look Of Things
Data:A u winter.json.descriptionunlocked: I followed in the footsteps of Solomon Husher.

Data:A v history wheeloffortune.json.label: Destiny
Data:A v history wheeloffortune.json.descriptionunlocked: I unlocked the Wheel of Fortune card.

Data:A v numen alte.json.label: Numen: a Merciless Alteration
Data:A v numen alte.json.descriptionunlocked: The fundamental flaw; the irresistible shortcut; the hate that heats; the change that mars; the scar that opens...

Data:A v numen asce.json.label: Numen: the Paths of the Sun
Data:A v numen asce.json.descriptionunlocked: The Sun has charted his Paths - paths beyond walls and woods and Bounds. When we are ready, all of us will enter Eternity...

Data:A v numen bala.json.label: Numen: Back into Balance
Data:A v numen bala.json.descriptionunlocked: When the travelling Carapace-kinds passed beyond the wave and the sky, they made arrangements for their return...

Data:A v numen bell.json.label: Numen: the Bells of Ys
Data:A v numen bell.json.descriptionunlocked: Ys, by her arts, found the strike-tone that shakes the Hours. A bell cast with this secret could speak the Ys-note...

Data:A v numen conf.json.label: Numen: Inescapable Confinement
Data:A v numen conf.json.descriptionunlocked: There's only one place you're safe from Eternity and History, and it's not a place anyone would want to be...

Data:A v numen desc.json.label: Numen: The Sun's Weakness
Data:A v numen desc.json.descriptionunlocked: The Sun's sins and the Sun's scars are our salvation. There are Histories where they will trap us...

Data:A v numen feas.json.label: Numen: an Irresistible Feast
Data:A v numen feas.json.descriptionunlocked: Hunger made Worms of Dragons. But without the savour-secret of the Carapace, their hunger would not have been sufficient...

Data:A v numen loop.json.label: Numen: Loopholes
Data:A v numen loop.json.descriptionunlocked: When Eternity came into the world, certain prudent powers arranged loopholes. Those loopholes may open again...

Data:A v numen oldl.json.label: Numen: That Old Lost Music
Data:A v numen oldl.json.descriptionunlocked: Every song ever sung still lingers in wind and echo, untouched by the demands of Eternity...

Data:A v numen secr.json.label: Numen: the Great Counterfeit
Data:A v numen secr.json.descriptionunlocked: The Sun-in-Splendour and the Forge of the Days could not be joined. But Sunset Celia and the Swan King could...

Data:A v numen thre.json.label: Numen: Three Rules
Data:A v numen thre.json.descriptionunlocked: If we know those deepest rules, we know what even the Chancel and the Calyptra may not do...

Data:A v numen unde.json.label: Numen: A Final Understanding
Data:A v numen unde.json.descriptionunlocked: Eternity and History cannot be reconciled. Freedom cannot be perfection - not unless we understand the paradox of the eternal ending...

Data:A v numen worl.json.label: Numen: Weaving the World
Data:A v numen worl.json.descriptionunlocked: The Histories, they say, are braided like hair - or tangled like roots. What is the shape of that knot...?

Data:A v origin archaeologist.json.label: Naming the Shadow
Data:A v origin archaeologist.json.descriptionunlocked: I have faced my Crime and the Curse it freed. At last, I am whole.

Data:A v origin artist.json.label: Perfectly Monstrous
Data:A v origin artist.json.descriptionunlocked: Those who go beneath the surface do so at their peril. Those who read the symbol do so at their peril. I went and read and mastered all.

Data:A v origin cartographer.json.label: Map of the Empire
Data:A v origin cartographer.json.descriptionunlocked: I plumbed the depths. I plotted the impossible. I completed my masterwork, and mastered the Mansus itself.

Data:A v origin executioner.json.label: Apology Accepted
Data:A v origin executioner.json.descriptionunlocked: They had hands, organs, dimensions, senses, affections, passions. I know that now. I made, at last, amends.

Data:A v origin magnate.json.label: Les Neiges D'Antan
Data:A v origin magnate.json.descriptionunlocked: Neither rags nor riches soothed my soul. But at last I found peace in Hush House.

Data:A v origin prodigal.json.label: A Reckoning Postponed Indefinitely
Data:A v origin prodigal.json.descriptionunlocked: I was hunted. I was afraid. But now I am safe, and prepared.

Data:A v origin revolutionary.json.label: Look on my Works,Ye Mighty
Data:A v origin revolutionary.json.descriptionunlocked: I spoke the name 'Calyptra' and lived. I won the last revolution, and I am free.

Data:A v origin symurgist.json.label: The Songs of Caer Adar
Data:A v origin symurgist.json.descriptionunlocked: I eavesdropped on the Aviform Hours and live, still, to sing their songs.

Data:A v origin twiceborn.json.label: A Third Way
Data:A v origin twiceborn.json.descriptionunlocked: I walked beneath the Sun, and I walked within the flesh. At last I found my final home.

Data:A write invitation.json.label: The Last Homely House
Data:A write invitation.json.descriptionunlocked: I wrote an Invitation to a Visitor.

Data:A write manuscript.json.label: Books Are The Memory That Does Not Die
